lessons.title: First Watt
lessons.concept: Power: kW is a rate, capacity is a ceiling, and load above capacity means a blackout.
lessons.goal: Two racks, one day, no blackouts.

steps.text: Build your first rack on the glowing slot
say: Bea. Power. Welcome to the hall. Two racks, one full day, nothing goes dark. That's the job.
Racks tab in the build bar. Grab the AC-1, drop it on the glowing slot. Rest is locked till it's in.
after: Hear that? That's 40 kW, flat out. A {{kw|kW}} is a rate. How hard something's pulling right now.
Top bar's the whole hall. 93 kW, on a feeder that gives 120. Remember the 120.

steps.text: Build a second rack on the next slot
say: {{capacity|Capacity}} is the most a supply can give. This feeder tops out at 120 kW.
The hall burns 53 before any rack works. Air handler, lift, the intake. One rack takes it to 93.
Put the second one in. Watch the bar.
after: And there it goes. Two racks want 133 kW. The feeder gives 120. Breaker trips.
Load over capacity is a blackout. Every time. Keep capacity above load, with {{headroom|headroom}} to spare.
Power overlay's on so you can see the net. Next bit I hate. A generator.

steps.text: Add the diesel generator in Power
say: Power tab. Diesel Genset. Glowing slot. It starts itself when the grid can't keep up.
A {{genset|generator}} adds capacity. 120 from the feeder, plus 800 from the diesel. And smoke. Smoke doesn't wash out.
Today it's the right tool. Later I'll show you better ones.
after: See the gap between what you can supply and what you're using? That's {{headroom|headroom}}. Loads of it now.
Hold both racks flat out for one game day and you pass.

steps.text: Hold both racks at full load for one day
say: Let the clock run. Keep headroom above 10% all day. Nothing goes dark.
I'll watch the meter. And the exhaust.

lessons.learned: {{kw|kW}} is how hard equipment pulls right now. {{capacity|Capacity}} is the most the supply can give. Keep capacity above load, with {{headroom|headroom}} to spare.
lessons.outro: Two racks, a whole day, lights on. Okay. Good. Next time I'll show you power that doesn't come out of a tank. When you want to know where all the heat goes, find Cass. She'll ask if you slept.
